title: 陈述句的言外之意
goal: 判断陈述句的交际意图，并选择与困难、情绪和消息相符的回应。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

points.label: 判断陈述句期待的回应类型

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 陈述句除了说明事实，还常用来表达困难、抱怨、道歉或感谢。合适的回应要接住这句话的用意，只谈同一话题不算回应。

body.box:
I can't get this lid off. → Let me try loosening it.
I'm sorry I chipped your bowl. → It's all right; it was already cracked.

body.p: 负面的陈述不都是求助。I’m sorry I chipped your bowl 是道歉，要回应道歉。I can’t get this lid off 是困难，要提供帮助。

steps.d: 先抓 can’t、sorry、thanks、again 等词，再看整句。The latch is stuck 是困难，I’m sorry I broke the latch 是道歉。
困难、抱怨、道歉、感谢和消息，各要一种回应。I finally qualified for the final 是好消息，回应用 Congratulations。
看帮助是否针对原来的问题，情绪是否和消息相符。The latch is stuck 后接 Let me loosen it 合适。I repaired a different latch 说的是另一个插销。

cards.title: 陈述句与回应
rows: 困难
针对眼前的问题提出建议或帮助。
I can't reach the valve. → I'll get a step stool.
抱怨
认可不便，或提出改进的办法。
The tap keeps dripping. → Let's report it to maintenance.
道歉
接受道歉，可以再说怎么补救。
Sorry I spilled the juice. → That's all right; I'll get a cloth.
感谢
用客气话回应感谢。
Thanks for checking the measurements. → Glad I could help.
好消息
表示祝贺或高兴。
I've been chosen for the orchestra. → Congratulations.
坏消息
表示遗憾，或提供实际的帮助。
My entry wasn't accepted. → I'm sorry to hear that.
安排信息
表示知道了，或据此调整安排。
The tutor will call after six. → I'll keep my phone nearby.

body.box: I can't read the tiny numbers on this pressure gauge.

Choose the best response.
1. Don't worry; it was already broken.
2. I read the instruction sheet yesterday.
3. The numbers run around the edge.
4. Here's a magnifying glass that might help.

body.p: can’t read 和 tiny numbers 说明困难在于数字太小。第四项递上放大镜，正好解决看不清的问题。
第一项把困难当成道歉来回应，还断定仪表坏了。第二项把读数字换成了读说明书，第三项只介绍数字的位置。这三项都没有解决看不清的问题。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 只复述事实
Thanks for measuring it. → I measured it.
感谢要用客气话回应，不是确认做过这件事。
套语错配
Sorry I spilled it. → You're welcome.
区分道歉与感谢。
对象替换
I can't read the gauge. → I read the manual.
核对困难针对的是哪件东西。
结果反转
My entry wasn't accepted. → Congratulations.
听清否定词，分清结果是好是坏。
推断过度
The numbers are tiny. → The gauge is broken.
看不清是因为数字小，不是仪表坏了。

lines.text: I can't fasten this necklace on my own.

options: Let me do the clasp for you.
Thanks, but I can manage it alone.
I fastened my coat earlier.
The necklace is silver.
items.why: can’t fasten 说明自己戴不上项链，第一项提出帮对方扣上。第二项像在谢绝别人的帮助，把说话人弄反了。

lines.text: The queue at this ticket machine hardly moves.

options: The tickets have printed numbers.
Congratulations; that's great news for you.
It's frustrating; let's try the staffed counter.
Good, I'm glad the machine is working so well today.
items.why: hardly moves 是在抱怨队伍太慢。第三项先认可不便，再提出去人工窗口。第四项把抱怨听成了满意。

lines.text: I'm sorry I knocked over your model tower.

options: The tower is taller than the house.
It's all right; we can rebuild that section.
You're welcome; it was no trouble at all.
Sorry, I'll be more careful next time.
items.why: I’m sorry 是为碰倒模型道歉。第二项接受道歉，并提出重搭那一段。第四项是回答的人在道歉，说话人弄反了。

lines.text: Thanks for explaining the rules of the card game.

options: Congratulations; you played really well tonight.
I explained a different game yesterday.
The rules are in the box.
You're welcome; I hope the next round is easier.
items.why: Thanks for explaining 是道谢，第四项用 You’re welcome 回应。第一项是对好消息的回应，接不上道谢。

lines.text: My short story has been accepted by the magazine.

options: The magazine comes out monthly.
I'm sorry to hear that; you can try another magazine.
You're welcome; I was glad to help you.
Congratulations; that's a real achievement.
items.why: has been accepted 是好消息，第四项用 Congratulations 祝贺。第二项把好消息听成了坏消息。

lines.text: The workshop won't repair my old camera.

options: What a pity; let's try another repair shop.
Congratulations; you must be really pleased.
Great, so you can collect it tomorrow morning.
The repair shop opened last month.
items.why: won’t repair 是坏消息。第一项表示遗憾，并提出另找一家店修。第三项没听到 won’t，把结果弄反了。

lines.text: The carpet cleaner is coming early tomorrow.

options: The carpet is darker than the curtains.
The cleaner came last summer.
Then I'll move the chairs out tonight.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear that.
items.why: coming early tomorrow 是一项安排。第三项据此决定今晚先把椅子搬走。

lines.text: I can't find the right socket for this bolt.

options: The bolt came in a small box.
Try the next size up; that one's too small.
You're welcome; it was no trouble to find it.
Yes, I found the right one yesterday.
items.why: can’t find the right socket 是找不到合适的套筒。第二项建议换大一号，针对的正是这个困难。

lines.text: The zipper on this sleeping bag won't close.

options: The bag was delivered on Tuesday.
Don't worry; I know you didn't mean to.
Let's see if the fabric is caught.
I closed the tent an hour ago.
items.why: won’t close 说明拉链拉不上。第三项提出先看看是不是夹住了布，是针对这个困难的帮助。

lines.text: We've had to fill out this same survey three times.

options: How annoying; I'll ask why it keeps coming.
The survey contains twelve questions.
Great, I'm glad you enjoy filling it out so much.
You're welcome; I sent it to you myself.
items.why: same survey three times 是在抱怨重复填表。第一项认可不便，并说会去问原因。第三项把抱怨听成了喜欢。

lines.text: I'm sorry I returned the rented skates with a broken lace.

options: The rental includes a helmet.
I'm sorry; I'll pay for the new lace.
You're welcome; enjoy the rest of your day.
That's fine; we can replace the lace here.
items.why: I’m sorry 是为鞋带断了道歉。第四项接受道歉，并说店里可以换鞋带。第二项是回答的人在道歉，说话人弄反了。

lines.text: Thanks for watering my balcony plants while I was away.

options: The balcony faces the courtyard.
Happy to help; they stayed in good shape.
Don't worry; it wasn't your fault at all.
I was away for a week last spring.
items.why: Thanks for watering 是道谢。第二项用 Happy to help 回应，并说花草长得不错。第三项是回应道歉的话。

lines.text: The panel has selected my proposal for the neighborhood mural.

options: Congratulations; I can't wait to see it.
The panel meets on Wednesdays.
I'm sorry; maybe they'll choose it next year.
Thanks, I'll paint it for you this weekend.
items.why: has selected 说明方案被选中，是好消息，第一项表示祝贺。第三项把选中听成了落选。

lines.text: Our rowing race has been canceled because of the wind.

options: Congratulations; you must be very proud.
The wind often changes in spring.
That's a shame; we had prepared for weeks.
Good, then I'll see you at the starting line.
items.why: has been canceled 是比赛取消的坏消息，第三项表示遗憾。第四项没听到取消，仍按比赛照常来回应。

lines.text: The new rug is arriving this afternoon.

options: The rug is woven from wool.
Then let's clear the floor before it comes.
Thanks, but I already returned it yesterday.
You're welcome; it was no trouble at all.
items.why: arriving this afternoon 是送货的安排。第二项据此提出在送到前把地面腾空。

lines.text: I'm unable to open the latch on this lunchbox.

options: The lunchbox contains two compartments.
I opened the kitchen door earlier.
You're welcome; I packed it for you.
Let me try pressing the release button.
items.why: unable to open the latch 说明打不开搭扣。第四项提出按一下开启按钮，是对应的帮助。第二项说的是另一扇门。
